ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon hands-on-keyboard discovery burst from a single shell
ucs.description: Volt Typhoon (a.k.a. Vanguard Panda / BRONZE SILHOUETTE / VOLTZITE — CISA AA24-038A) is documented running a rapid sequence of native Windows discovery LOLBins (net, ipconfig, systeminfo, tasklist, netstat, query/quser, nltest, whoami, ping, route, wmic) from a single cmd.exe or powershell.exe parent within minutes of gaining a foothold on an internet-facing edge appliance. This hunts ≥6 distinct discovery binaries spawned by ONE parent shell inside a 10-minute window, excluding service/computer accounts — the chain is the signal, not any one binary.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_recon values(Processes.process_name) as recon_bins values(Processes.process) as sample_cmds min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("net.exe","net1.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","netstat.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","query.exe","nltest.exe","ping.exe","tracert.exe","hostname.exe","wmic.exe","arp.exe","route.exe") AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND NOT (Processes.user IN ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") OR Processes.user="*$") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval window_min=(last_seen-first_seen)/60 | where distinct_recon>=6 AND window_min<=10 | sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
let RECON = dynamic(["net.exe","net1.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","netstat.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","query.exe","nltest.exe","ping.exe","tracert.exe","hostname.exe","wmic.exe","arp.exe","route.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where FileName in~ (RECON)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize DistinctRecon = dcount(FileName),
            ReconBins   = make_set(FileName, 30),
            SampleCmds  = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20),
            FirstSeen   = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen    = max(Timestamp)
        by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
           ParentShell = InitiatingProcessFileName,
           ParentPid   = InitiatingProcessId,
           ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| where DistinctRecon >= 6                  // empirical: Volt Typhoon CISA report shows 8-15 distinct LOLBins in <10m
| where datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen) <= 10
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RECON = dynamic(["net.exe","net1.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","netstat.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","query.exe","nltest.exe","ping.exe","tracert.exe","hostname.exe","wmic.exe","arp.exe","route.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend FileLeaf   = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ParentLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where FileLeaf in (RECON)
| where ParentLeaf in ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize DistinctRecon = dcount(FileLeaf),
            ReconBins   = make_set(FileLeaf, 30),
            SampleCmds  = make_set(CommandLine, 20),
            FirstSeen   = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen    = max(TimeGenerated)
        by Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentLeaf, ProcessId
| where DistinctRecon >= 6
| where datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen) <= 10
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @ParentImage:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\PWSH.EXE) @Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\ipconfig.exe OR *\\IPCONFIG.EXE OR *\\systeminfo.exe OR *\\SYSTEMINFO.EXE OR *\\tasklist.exe OR *\\TASKLIST.EXE OR *\\netstat.exe OR *\\NETSTAT.EXE OR *\\whoami.exe OR *\\WHOAMI.EXE OR *\\quser.exe OR *\\query.exe OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\NLTEST.EXE OR *\\ping.exe OR *\\PING.EXE OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE OR *\\hostname.exe OR *\\HOSTNAME.EXE OR *\\arp.exe OR *\\route.exe) -@User:*$ -@User:SYSTEM
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(net|net1|ipconfig|systeminfo|tasklist|netstat|whoami|quser|query|nltest|ping|tracert|hostname|wmic|arp|route)\.exe$/i
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(cmd|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ParentProcessId], function=[count(ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=distinct_recon), collect([ImageFileName]), min(@timestamp, as=first_seen), max(@timestamp, as=last_seen)])
| window_min := (last_seen - first_seen) / 60000
| distinct_recon >= 6
| window_min <= 10
| sort(first_seen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Volt Typhoon is the canonical LOTL actor — CISA AA24-038A and Microsoft's May 2023 'Volt Typhoon' report both call out an opening recon burst (net user/group, net localgroup administrators, ipconfig /all, systeminfo, tasklist /svc, netstat -ano, nltest /dclist, whoami /priv, ping <DC>) run from a single shell on a recently-compromised edge appliance. Single LOLBin invocations are noise; the chain

ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit theft via ntdsutil 'ifm' or VSS shadow-copy on a DC
ucs.description: Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE / DEV-0391, G1017) routinely steals the Active Directory database on victim DCs using two CISA-documented techniques: (1) ntdsutil with 'activate instance ntds' + 'ifm' + 'create full <path>', and (2) vssadmin 'create shadow' followed by copying \NTDS\ntds.dit out of GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy*. This is a single-event-shape detection (process create on a DC) — high signal, near-zero legitimate use outside a small set of backup tooling.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as commands values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ( (Processes.process_name=ntdsutil.exe AND (Processes.process="*ifm*" OR Processes.process="*create full*" OR Processes.process="*ac i ntds*" OR Processes.process="*activate instance*")) OR (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*create shadow*") OR Processes.process="*\\NTDS\\ntds.dit*" OR Processes.process="*GLOBALROOT\\Device\\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy*" ) AND NOT Processes.user="*$" by host Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where (FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
            and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm","create full","ac i ntds","activate instance"))
     or (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe"
            and ProcessCommandLine has "create shadow")
     or (FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","robocopy.exe","xcopy.exe","esentutl.exe"))
        and ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\NTDS\ntds.dit","GLOBALROOT\\Device\\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy","ntds.dit")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend FileLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where (FileLeaf == "ntdsutil.exe"
            and CommandLine has_any ("ifm","create full","ac i ntds","activate instance"))
     or (FileLeaf == "vssadmin.exe"
            and CommandLine has "create shadow")
     or (FileLeaf in ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","robocopy.exe","xcopy.exe","esentutl.exe")
            and CommandLine has_any (@"\NTDS\ntds.dit","GLOBALROOT\\Device\\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy"))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit Extraction via ntdsutil IFM or VSS Shadow Copy
id: 2c1e7c6a-5db0-4f8e-b9b3-volttyphoon-ntds
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects Volt Typhoon (G1017 / Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE) NTDS.dit credential
  theft as documented in CISA AA24-038A — ntdsutil 'ifm create full' on a DC,
  vssadmin 'create shadow' followed by copy from GLOBALROOT shadow path, or any
  ntds.dit handle on a non-DC backup account.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - attack.g1017
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  ntdsutil_ifm:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ifm'
      - 'create full'
      - 'ac i ntds'
      - 'activate instance ntds'
  vssadmin_shadow:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'create shadow'
      - '/for='
  shadow_copy_or_ntds_handle:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy'
      - '\NTDS\ntds.dit'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (ntdsutil_ifm or vssadmin_shadow or shadow_copy_or_ntds_handle) and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Authorised DC backup procedures (e.g. NTBACKUP / dedicated backup-service account — baseline and allow-list the principal/host pair)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) ((@Image:(*\\ntdsutil.exe OR *\\NTDSUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*ifm* OR *"create full"* OR *"ac i ntds"* OR *"activate instance"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*"create shadow"*) OR @CommandLine:(*"\\NTDS\\ntds.dit"* OR *GLOBALROOT\\Device\\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy*)) -@User:*$ -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)(ifm|create full|ac i ntds|activate instance)", field=CommandLine))
   OR (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)create shadow", field=CommandLine))
   OR regex("(?i)(\\\\NTDS\\\\ntds\\.dit|GLOBALROOT\\\\Device\\\\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| table([@timestamp, aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, SHA256HashData])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)
